import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb['5 groups']
print(f'Total rows: {ws.max_row}')
# Check the last rows to see where data ends
print('--- Last 5 rows ---')
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=ws.max_row-4, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    print(row)
# Count non-empty per column
counts = {}
for col_idx, col_letter in enumerate(['A','B','C','D','E'], 1):
    count = 0
    for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
        v = ws.cell(row=r, column=col_idx).value
        if v is not None and str(v).strip() != '':
            count += 1
    counts[col_letter] = count
print('Non-empty counts per column:', counts)
"

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(ggplot2)
})
# Read the Excel file (path relative to data kernel cwd)
input_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(input_path, sheet = "5 groups")
cat("Dimensions:", dim(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
str(df)

# Compute all region counts (intersection table) and draw proportional Venn diagram
venn_obj <- Venn(sets)
region_counts <- process_region_data(Venn(sets))
cat("Region counts table (head):\n")
print(head(as.data.frame(region_counts), 15))
cat("\nTotal distinct regions:", nrow(region_counts), "\n")
# Proportional (area-aware) Venn diagram
p_prop <- ggVennDiagram(
  sets,
  label_alpha      = 0,
  label_geom       = "label",
  set_size         = 5,
  label_size       = 3.2
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4FAFE", high = "#4981BF") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Synthetic Venn diagram (Proportional Venn Diagram of 5 sets)")
print(p_prop)
# Save PNG to the session data dir
ggsave("proportional_venn_5sets.png", p_prop, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)
cat("\nSaved: proportional_venn_5sets.png\n")
